7812.title: iOS capture and external-audio coexistence
7812.rootCauseOneLine: Capture uses WebKit browser APIs without an app-owned native mixing policy; the proposed iOS audio-session interruption remains device-unverified.

prReviews.verdict: NOT VERIFIED — closed, unmerged; static review only
prReviews.topFinding: Native startup enables recording mode before preparation without a failure cleanup path; no physical-device coexistence result was verified.

7812.proposedFix: Measure the interruption and active session policy on a physical iPhone before designing native recording and lifecycle cleanup. No automatic PR is safe without a faithful failing regression; a native bridge/dependency change also exceeds simple-fix scope.
7812.caveats: The same agent repeated only a production-helper diagnostic with injected mediaDevices in a second clean checkout. No iOS runtime, real microphone, external playback, or session category was exercised. Partial verification does not confirm the audible symptom. Diagnostic source and observed output are inline to respect the reports repository's no-script/no-log publication policy.
